    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.lemma8

    BO13a Lemma 8: the factorization of a neighbour stops after one step #

    MulBasis.lemma8: in a minimal crown (every long morphism in a contour), let σ₁ be long with a contour (v₁ v₂, w) and ρ₁ = v₁ ≫ ρ₁'. Then σ₂ does not factor as σ₂' ≫ ρ₁'. The contour is permeable or reflecting by Lemma 5 a) (l8_perm, l8_claim, l8_refl). Reconstruction: notes/2026-10-30-074207-bo13a-lemma8-reconstruction.md.
